soft_preferences.note: SOFT. These never filter or suppress anything. Report the cheapest option ALWAYS, even if it matches none of these. Then separately report the closest match, and let the traveler choose.
soft_preferences.second_best: any airport within 1000 miles of DEN
soft_preferences.weighting: airport location matters slightly more than any other single factor

bag_estimate_warning: estimated_bag_usd is a PLACEHOLDER for any airline listed in airlines_needing_policy_lookup. Verify the real published policy before trusting estimated_all_in_usd.

United: First checked bag $45 online for US-Central America ($70 range at airport / on some Basic fares). IMPORTANT: Guatemala counts as SHORT-HAUL international, where United Basic Economy allows a PERSONAL ITEM ONLY - no full-size carry-on. The free-carry-on rule people cite applies to transatlantic/transpacific/South America, not Central America. carryon_usd is 0 because it cannot be bought on Basic; you must buy up to a Standard Economy fare.
